textPlacement.assessment: Both contexts retain communication before words and respectful touch alongside gentle assistance for necessary care.
Both contexts preserve flexible family rhythm and shared use of picture reminders without requiring independent checklist use.
Both contexts retain the unaged toddler family-ritual discussion and simple culturally personal shared occasions.
Both contexts retain tentative interpretation, the continued-throwing limit and food-concern qualifications without treating throwing as proof of sufficient intake.
Both contexts preserve the chart and appendix age variants, partial dressing participation and changing needs for gentle adult help.
Both contexts preserve supported ordinary washing separately from the later repeating table setup and its jug-carrying condition.
Both contexts retain the attributed toddler-mealtime perspective, supported participation and medical qualification without an independent-eating requirement.
Both contexts retain supervised shared grooming, the differing chart and appendix ages, and wiping as the offered tissue movement.
Both contexts retain the young-toddler family-change discussion with observation and sleep support, without converting it into a new age deadline.
Both contexts preserve family-specific sleep choices, support during illness or teething, no crying alone and specialist help for persistent difficulty.
Both contexts retain the child’s possible turn with adult finishing and gentle necessary care rather than independent brushing or official dental guidance.
Both contexts preserve readiness signs rather than ages, no forcing or interruption of absorbed activity and the medical qualification.
Both contexts retain concrete preparation and gentle follow-through without requiring clock-time comprehension or acceptance of choices.
The new context retains unhurried assisted coat practice within the chart’s eighteen-month-to-three range and the source illustration’s movement.
The new summary preserves the chart’s face and body washing ages and small soap container while keeping care shared, communicative and gently assisted.
